words.w: Glad to meet you here
words.tr: phrase. 很高兴在这里见到你
words.ex: I am glad to meet you here.
words.ex_cn: 我很高兴在这里见到你。

words.w: How nice to see you
words.tr: phrase. 真高兴见到你
words.ex: How nice to see you after all these years!
words.ex_cn: 这么多年后真高兴见到你！

words.w: Fancy seeing you
words.tr: 幻想见到你
words.ex: Fancy seeing you here after all these years!
words.ex_cn: 幻想见到你，这么多年后在这里！

words.w: How are you
words.tr: phrase. 你好吗？（用于问候他人近况）
words.ex: Hi, how are you?
words.ex_cn: 嗨，你好吗？
words.en: A common greeting used to ask about someone's well-being.

words.w: I'm glad to have had the opportunity to meet you here
words.tr: phrase. 很高兴在这里有机会见到你
words.ex: I'm glad to have had the opportunity to meet you here.
words.ex_cn: 很高兴在这里有机会见到你。

words.w: I'm glad to meet you
words.tr: 我很高兴见到你
words.ex: I'm glad to meet you at the school party.
words.ex_cn: 我很高兴在学校的派对上见到你。
words.en: A standard greeting when meeting someone for the first time.

words.w: I'm pleased to meet you
words.tr: phrase. 很高兴见到您。
words.ex: I'm pleased to meet you at the conference.
words.ex_cn: 我很高兴在会议上见到您。

words.w: It's a pleasure to meet you
words.tr: phrase. 很高兴见到你
words.ex: It's a pleasure to meet you, I'm happy to be here.
words.ex_cn: 很高兴见到你，我很高兴来到这里。

words.w: Could you please rephrase that question
words.tr: phrase. 您能重新表述一下那个问题吗？
words.ex: Could you please rephrase that question?
words.ex_cn: 您能重新表述一下那个问题吗？

words.w: I'm not exactly sure what you mean
words.tr: phrase. 我不太确定你的意思
words.ex: I'm not exactly sure what you mean when you say 'fast food'.
words.ex_cn: 当你说到‘快餐’时，我不太确定你的意思。

words.w: Do you mean
words.tr: phrase. 你是说……吗？（用于确认对方的意思）
words.ex: Do you mean this book?
words.ex_cn: 你的意思是这本书记吗？
words.en: A question seeking clarification or confirmation about the meaning of a previous statement.

words.w: If I understand right
words.tr: phrase. 如果我没理解错的话
words.ex: If I understand right, you want to leave early today.
words.ex_cn: 如果我没理解错的话，你是想今天早点走。

words.w: I'm sorry if I'm being a little slow but
words.tr: phrase. 对不起，如果我有点反应慢的话，但是
words.ex: I'm sorry if I'm being a little slow but, what does this word mean?
words.ex_cn: 对不起，如果我有点反应慢的话，但是这个词是什么意思？

words.w: I'm sorry I'm not sure I understand. Do you mean
words.tr: phrase. 抱歉，我不太确定我明白了。你的意思是
words.ex: I'm sorry I'm not sure I understand. Do you mean we should leave now?
words.ex_cn: 抱歉，我不太确定我明白了。你的意思是我们现在就走吗？

words.w: So am I right in saying
words.tr: phrase. 所以我的理解是对的吗？
words.ex: You helped me finish the project, so am I right in saying you're happy with the result?
words.ex_cn: 你帮我完成了这个项目，所以我的理解是对的吗？你对结果很满意？

words.w: If I've got the picture then
words.tr: phrase. 如果我理解正确的话，那么；如果我没弄错的话
words.ex: If I've got the picture then, you want to leave early.
words.ex_cn: 如果我理解正确的话，那么你是想早点离开。

words.w: So what you mean is right
words.tr: phrase. 所以你的意思是正确的。
words.ex: You said the answer is 5, so what you mean is right.
words.ex_cn: 你说答案是5，所以你的意思是正确的。

words.w: Sorry I don't quite catch you. You mean
words.tr: phrase. 抱歉，我没太明白你的意思。
words.ex: Sorry I don't quite catch you. You mean we should leave now?
words.ex_cn: 抱歉，我没太明白你的意思。你是说我们现在就走吗？

words.w: Can I get one thing clear
words.tr: phrase. 我能弄清楚一件事吗？无中文释义
words.ex: Can I get one thing clear: are we meeting tomorrow?
words.ex_cn: 我能弄清楚一件事吗：我们明天见面吗？

words.w: Would I be correct in supposin
words.tr: phrase. 我这样假设对吗？无中文释义

chapters.name: list4. 对问题内容不熟悉

words.w: I'm not exactly sure how to answer that question but
words.tr: phrase. 我不太确定该怎么回答这个问题，但
words.ex: I'm not exactly sure how to answer that question but I think it's about friendship.
words.ex_cn: 我不太确定该怎么回答这个问题，但我觉得是关于友谊的。

words.w: That's a rather difficult question but
words.tr: phrase. 这是个相当困难的问题，但
words.ex: That's a rather difficult question but I'll try to answer it.
words.ex_cn: 这是个相当困难的问题，但我试着回答它。

words.w: I'm sorry but I don't know much about
words.tr: phrase. 很抱歉，我对这个不太了解
words.ex: I'm sorry but I don't know much about this topic.
words.ex_cn: 很抱歉，我对这个不太了解。

chapters.name: list5. 评价考官所提问题

words.w: That's difficult to answer but maybe
words.tr: phrase. 这很难回答，但也许
words.ex: That's difficult to answer but maybe he will call later.
words.ex_cn: 这很难回答，但也许他稍后会打电话。

words.w: I'm sorry but I don't know much about but perhaps
words.tr: phrase. 无中文释义
words.ex: I'm sorry but I don't know much about but perhaps my friend can help.
words.ex_cn: 对不起，我对这个不太了解，但也许我的朋友能帮忙。

words.w: Maybe I can answer your question by telling you about a personal experience I had
words.tr: phrase. 也许我可以通过讲述我自己的亲身经历来回答你的问题

words.w: That's an interesting question let me see. Well I suppose that
words.tr: phrase. 那是个有趣的问题，让我想想。嗯，我猜那
words.ex: That's an interesting question let me see. Well I suppose that you like pizza.
words.ex_cn: 那是个有趣的问题，让我想想。嗯，我猜你喜欢披萨。

words.w: Yes that's a big issue
words.tr: phrase. 是的，那是个大问题
words.ex: Yes, that's a big issue when we don't have enough water.
words.ex_cn: 是的，当我们没有足够的水时，那是个大问题。

words.w: Well
words.tr:
adv. 好；对；满意地；
int. （用于表示惊讶，疑虑，接受等）好；
n. 井；
adj. 健康的；
words.ex: She sings well.
words.ex_cn: 她唱得很好。
words.en: In a good or satisfactory manner; in a thorough manner; in a manner that is appropriate or suitable.

words.w: Actually
words.tr: adv. 事实上；实际上；竟然；
words.ex: I thought he was late, but actually he was on time.
words.ex_cn: 我以为他迟到了，但事实上他准时到了。
words.en: You use actually to indicate that a situation exists or happened, or to emphasize that it is true.

words.w: In fact
words.tr: phrase. 事实上；实际上
words.ex: He says he likes sports, but in fact, he hates them.
words.ex_cn: 他说他喜欢运动，但事实上，他讨厌它们。
words.en: You use in fact to emphasize that something is true, especially when it contradicts what has just been said or might be expected.

words.w: You see
words.tr: 短语. 你明白；你看；你知道（用于解释或引起注意）
words.ex: You see the bird flying in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 你看到鸟在天上飞。
words.en: Used to introduce an explanation or to check if someone understands.

words.w: You know
words.tr: 短语. 你知道；你明白（常用于口语中，表示对方应理解或认同）
words.ex: You know, I like math.
words.ex_cn: 你知道吗，我喜欢数学。
words.en: Used to indicate that you are thinking about what to say next, or to emphasize what you have just said.

words.w: How shall I put it
words.tr: 短语 我该怎么说呢；不知该如何表达
words.ex: How shall I put it? The movie was boring but had a good ending.
words.ex_cn: 我该怎么说呢？这部电影很无聊，但结局不错。
words.en: Used to express difficulty in finding the right words.

words.w: Let me think for a second
words.tr: 让我想一下（用于表示需要短暂时间思考）
words.uk: let mi θɪŋk fɔː(r) ə ˈsekənd
words.us: let mi θɪŋk fɔːr ə ˈsekənd
words.ex: Let me think for a second before I answer.
words.ex_cn: 在我回答之前，让我想一下。
words.en: A request for a short pause to consider a response or idea.

words.w: Give me a few seconds
words.tr: phrase. 给我几秒钟
words.ex: Give me a few seconds to finish this problem.
words.ex_cn: 给我几秒钟完成这个问题。

words.w: In other words I am
words.tr: phrase. 换句话说，我是无中文释义
words.ex: I failed the test; in other words, I am not ready yet.
words.ex_cn: 我考试没通过；换句话说，我还没准备好。

words.w: And that means
words.tr: conj. 而且那意味着；并且那表示
words.ex: He failed the test, and that means he must retake it.
words.ex_cn: 他考试没及格，这意味着他必须重考。
words.en: That is the result or implication of the previous statement.

words.w: Let me put it another way
words.tr: phrase. 换句话说；让我换种说法
words.ex: I don't like the job; let me put it another way, I want a new career.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢这份工作；换句话说，我想换一份新职业。

words.w: What I'm suggesting is
words.tr: 我所建议的是
words.ex: What I'm suggesting is that we leave early.
words.ex_cn: 我建议我们早点出发。
words.en: used to introduce a suggestion or proposal, often in a formal or persuasive context.

words.w: All I 'm trying to say is
words.tr: phrase. 我想说的只是
words.ex: All I'm trying to say is that you should rest today.
words.ex_cn: 我想说的只是你应该今天休息。

words.w: What I'm getting at is
words.tr: phrase. 我的意思是；我想表达的是
words.ex: I don't like the plan, what I'm getting at is we need a better one.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢这个计划，我的意思是我们需要一个更好的。

words.w: If I can rephrase that
words.tr: phrase. 如果我可以重新表述那句话
words.ex: If I can rephrase that, it means we should try again.
words.ex_cn: 如果我可以重新表述那句话，意思是我们应该再试一次。

words.w: Perhaps I should make that clearer by saying
words.tr: phrase. 也许我该说清楚一点
words.ex: Perhaps I should make that clearer by saying we need more time.
words.ex_cn: 也许我该说清楚一点，我们需要更多时间。

words.w: Perhaps it would be more accurate to say
words.tr: phrase. 也许更准确的说法是

words.w: The point I'm making is that
words.tr: phrase. 我要表达的是
words.ex: The point I'm making is that you should study every day.
words.ex_cn: 我要表达的是，你应该每天学习。

chapters.name: list8. 回答完毕，询问考官是否还需补充其他信息

words.w: Have I given you enough information
words.tr: phrase. 我提供的信息够不够？
words.ex: Have I given you enough information to understand the plan?
words.ex_cn: 我提供的信息够不够让你理解这个计划？

words.w: Would you like me to tell you more about
words.tr: phrase. 您要我为您详细讲讲关于……吗
words.ex: Would you like me to tell you more about the history of this town?
words.ex_cn: 您要我为您详细讲讲关于这个小镇的历史吗？

words.w: Is that all you'd like to know
words.tr: phrase. 这就是你想知道的全部了吗？
words.ex: Is that all you'd like to know about the trip?
words.ex_cn: 这就是你想知道的关于这次旅行的全部了吗？

words.w: Is there anything else you wish to know
words.tr: phrase. 还有什么其他你想了解的吗？
words.ex: Is there anything else you wish to know about the trip?
words.ex_cn: 关于这次旅行，还有什么其他你想了解的吗？

chapters.name: list9. 回答完毕，考生认为已无话可说了

words.w: I'm afraid that's about as much as I know
words.tr: phrase. 恐怕我知道的就这么多
words.ex: I'm afraid that's about as much as I know about the history of this town.
words.ex_cn: 恐怕我知道的就这么多关于这个小镇的历史。

words.w: I think that's all
words.tr: phrase. 我认为就这些了。
words.ex: I think that's all for today.
words.ex_cn: 我认为今天就这些了。

words.w: I can't think of anything else right now
words.tr: phrase. 我现在想不出别的了
words.ex: I can't think of anything else right now.
words.ex_cn: 我现在想不出别的了。

words.w: That's very kind of you. Thank you
words.tr: phrase. 你真好，谢谢。
words.ex: You helped me carry the bags? That's very kind of you. Thank you.
words.ex_cn: 你帮我拿包？你真好，谢谢。

words.w: Thank you very much for giving me information
words.tr: phrase. 非常感谢你提供给我信息
words.ex: Thank you very much for giving me information about the train schedule.
words.ex_cn: 非常感谢你提供给我关于火车时刻表的信息。

words.w: Well thanks for talking to me and I wish you all the best
words.tr: phrase. 嗯，谢谢你和我聊天，祝你一切顺利。
words.ex: Well thanks for talking to me and I wish you all the best.
words.ex_cn: 嗯，谢谢你和我聊天，祝你一切顺利。

words.w: Thank you sir
words.tr: 感谢您，先生
words.ex: Thank you sir, for helping me with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 感谢您，先生，帮我完成了作业。
words.en: A polite expression of gratitude directed at a man.

words.w: Nice talking to you
words.tr: 很高兴与你交谈
words.ex: It was nice talking to you before you left.
words.ex_cn: 在你离开前和你交谈很高兴。

words.w: I appreciate your talking with me. Goodbye
words.tr: phrase. 我感谢你和我交谈。再见
words.ex: I appreciate your talking with me. Goodbye.
words.ex_cn: 我感谢你和我交谈。再见。

words.w: I enjoyed talking to you
words.tr: phrase. 我很喜欢和你聊天。
words.ex: I enjoyed talking to you after class.
words.ex_cn: 我很喜欢和你聊天。

words.w: It's been very helpful talking to you
words.tr: phrase. 和你交谈非常有帮助
words.ex: It's been very helpful talking to you about my homework.
words.ex_cn: 和你交谈关于我的作业非常有帮助。

chapters.name: list11. 回答考官居就某事征求你意见

words.w: As far as I'm concerned I think
words.tr: phrase. 就我而言，我认为
words.ex: As far as I'm concerned, I think we should leave now.
words.ex_cn: 就我而言，我认为我们现在应该离开。

words.w: In my opinion
words.tr: phrase. 在我看来；依我之见；我认为
words.ex: In my opinion, this book is very good.
words.ex_cn: 在我看来，这本书非常好。
words.en: Used to introduce a personal viewpoint or belief.

words.w: It seems to me
words.tr: 在我看来
words.ex: It seems to me that the sky is blue.
words.ex_cn: 在我看来，天空是蓝色的。
words.en: In my opinion or from my perspective.

words.w: From where I stand it is
words.tr: phrase. 依我看来；据我所知；从我的立场来看是
words.ex: From where I stand it is clear that we need more time.
words.ex_cn: 依我看来，我们需要更多时间。

words.w: What I reckon is
words.tr: phrase. 我认为是；我觉得是
words.ex: What I reckon is that we should leave early.
words.ex_cn: 我认为我们应该早点离开。

words.w: I'd like to point out that
words.tr: phrase. 我想指出的是
words.ex: I'd like to point out that the book is on the table.
words.ex_cn: 我想指出的是，书在桌子上。

words.w: If I may say so this is
words.tr: phrase. 如果我可以这么说的话，这是无中文释义
words.ex: If I may say so this is the best coffee I've ever had.
words.ex_cn: 如果我可以这么说的话，这是我一直喝过的最好的咖啡。

words.w: I'm convinced that
words.tr: 我确信……
words.ex: I'm convinced that hard work leads to success.
words.ex_cn: 我坚信努力工作会带来成功。
words.en: An expression used to introduce a statement that one firmly believes or is certain about.

words.w: Personally I consider
words.tr: phrase. 就我个人而言，我认为
words.ex: Personally I consider this the best way to learn English.
words.ex_cn: 就我个人而言，我认为这是学习英语最好的方式。

chapters.name: list12. 表达对未来的找算和态度

words.w: Well as you know at the moment I'm studying at
words.tr: phrase. 无中文释义
words.ex: Well as you know at the moment I'm studying at the local library.
words.ex_cn: 正如你所知，我现在正在当地图书馆学习。

words.w: I'm preparing right now to go to university so my short-term plan is to
words.tr: phrase. 我现在正在准备上大学，所以我的短期计划是
words.ex: I'm preparing right now to go to university so my short-term plan is to study hard and pass the entrance exam.
words.ex_cn: 我现在正在准备上大学，所以我的短期计划是努力学习并通过入学考试。

words.w: If I'm not successful that is
words.tr: phrase. 如果我不成功，那就是
words.ex: If I'm not successful that is, I will try again next year.
words.ex_cn: 如果我不成功，那就是我明年再试。

words.w: if something goes wrong I think I will probably
words.tr: phrase. 如果出问题了，我想我可能会无中文释义
words.ex: If something goes wrong, I think I will probably call for help.
words.ex_cn: 如果出问题了，我想我可能会求助。

words.w: In the future I would like to complete a master's degree
words.tr: phrase. 未来我希望能完成硕士学位。
words.ex: In the future I would like to complete a master's degree.
words.ex_cn: 未来我希望能完成硕士学位。

words.w: I do not know if I will but I might be able to
words.tr: phrase. 我不知道我是否会，但我可能能做到。

words.w: I feel inclined to
words.tr: phrase. 我觉得有倾向做；我倾向于
words.ex: I feel inclined to help my friend with homework.
words.ex_cn: 我觉得有倾向帮朋友做作业。

words.w: I'll do all I can to
words.tr: phrase. 我会尽我所能去
words.ex: I'll do all I can to help you finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 我会尽我所能去帮你完成这个项目。

words.w: I reckon I'll
words.tr: phrase. 我想我会（无中文释义）
words.ex: I reckon i'll go to the park after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 我想我会午饭后去公园。

words.w: I'm figuring on
words.tr: phrase. 我打算；我指望；我预计无中文释义
words.ex: I'm figuring on going to the park this weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我打算这个周末去公园。

words.w: I have every intention of
words.tr: phrase. 我完全打算做……
words.ex: I have every intention of finishing my homework tonight.
words.ex_cn: 我完全打算今晚完成我的作业。

chapters.name: list13. 表示喜欢某人或某事

words.w: I have a fancy for
words.tr: phrase. 我对……有偏好；我钟情于……
words.ex: I have a fancy for chocolate ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 我对巧克力冰淇淋有偏好。

words.w: I don't think I've seen anything I like better
words.tr: phrase. 我觉得我从未见过比这更喜欢的东西。
words.ex: I don't think I've seen anything I like better than this cake.
words.ex_cn: 我觉得我从未见过比这蛋糕更喜欢的东西。

words.w: I'm very keen on outdoor sports
words.tr: phrase. 我非常热衷于户外运动
words.ex: I'm very keen on outdoor sports like hiking and cycling.
words.ex_cn: 我非常热衷于徒步和骑自行车等户外运动。

words.w: I've always liked fishing
words.tr: phrase. 我一直喜欢钓鱼
words.ex: I've always liked fishing by the lake on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 我一直喜欢在周末去湖边钓鱼。

words.w: is a marvelous way of spending a day off
words.tr: phrase. 是度过假日的绝佳方式
words.ex: Reading a book is a marvelous way of spending a day off.
words.ex_cn: 读书是度过假日的绝佳方式。

words.w: There's nothing I enjoy more than
words.tr: phrase. 我最喜欢的就是；没有什么比……更让我享受的了
words.ex: There's nothing I enjoy more than reading books in the park.
words.ex_cn: 我最喜欢的就是在公园里读书。

words.w: I'm crazy about
words.tr: 我对...着迷；我非常喜欢
words.ex: I'm crazy about playing soccer with my friends.
words.ex_cn: 我痴迷于和朋友们踢足球。
words.en: To be very enthusiastic or passionate about something or someone.

words.w: I can't find words to express how much I like it
words.tr: phrase. 我无法用言语表达我有多喜欢它
words.ex: I can't find words to express how much I like it when you cook for me.
words.ex_cn: 当你为我做饭时，我无法用言语表达我有多喜欢它。

words.w: I have a particular fondness for pop song
words.tr: phrase. 我对流行歌曲有特别的喜爱。
words.ex: I have a particular fondness for pop song.
words.ex_cn: 我对流行歌曲有特别的喜爱。

words.w: Walking is one of my favorite pastimes
words.tr: phrase. 散步是我最喜欢的消遣之一
words.ex: Walking is one of my favorite pastimes.
